meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo-senpi. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo input hook injects the full directive as a hidden custom message (customType omo-ultrawork:directive, display false) ahead of the user's text, which is left untouched; a prompt queued while the agent is streaming instead carries the directive appended inside that same message. The directive is present in the conversation context; on the idle path it is not shown in the visible prompt, while a queued prompt carries the directive visibly (exactly as before this change). When the directive is already present in the conversation, do not read this file again - this file is that same directive. Read this file only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already present in the conversation.

copy.tagline: 启用预设的强化工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望用特定词触发系统进入工作状态。
copy.tagline_en: Activate a preset enhanced work mode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a keyword to switch the system into work mode.

howto.what: 触发后，Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式：首行显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，随后以证据驱动工作——使用记忆、制定并执行详细计划、用真实测试与操作结果证明任务完成，并记录全过程。
howto.when: 当你的话里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，为我修复这个 bug，并展示测试证据。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败测试，修复后提供通过证据。

say.text: 用 ulw 模式实现新功能，并做真实接口验证。
say.note: Claude 会创建目标并执行真实场景验证。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork，完成这次重构，记录所有发现。
say.note: Claude 会建立记事本并全程记录。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude enters ultrawork mode: the first visible line is 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then it works evidence-driven — uses memory, plans in detail, proves each deliverable with real tests/operations, and logs everything.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix this bug with test evidence.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing test first, then fixes and shows it pass.

say_en.text: Use ulw mode to implement the new feature with real API verification.
say_en.note: Claude registers a goal, applies tiering, and runs real-surface QA.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork to do this refactor and log all findings.
say_en.note: Claude opens a notepad and records every step.
